Description of original award (Fiscal Year 2024, $450,000)

Example Family Services Inc will provide trauma-focused family therapy to children who are victims of crime and to their non-offending caregivers in Salt Lake and Tooele counties.

The project will reduce wait times for a first session from six weeks to two weeks, train eight licensed clinicians in an evidence-based model, and coordinate referrals with the juvenile court & child advocacy centers.

Expected outcomes include 240 families served over 36 months and improved scores on a standardized trauma symptom checklist.
